articles.title: From Phuket to the Big Stage: How Nene Royal Shredded Her Way to a Million Dollars
articles.summary: Nene Royal, a 16-year-old metal fan from Thailand, won America's Got Talent with her electric guitar. Her audition went viral with 21 million views. Now she's planning a rock album and a tour.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo's Unraveled Tour Blooms With Wildflowers, a Dissolving Dress, and a Birthday Song for Mom
articles.summary: Olivia Rodrigo launched her Unraveled Tour in Hartford with a stage full of wildflowers, a dissolving dress, and a touching birthday tribute to her mom. The two-hour show featured hits from all three albums.

articles.title: Great Britain's Billie Jean King Cup Run Ends Against a Powerful Czech Team
articles.summary: Great Britain lost to the Czech Republic in the Billie Jean King Cup quarter-finals. Sonay Kartal fought through a three-hour match after injury, but the Czechs proved too strong. Captain Anne Keothavong praised her team's effort.
